description: The hold_queue chart with idle and awaiting_pickup inside a compound state open, whose own copy.disputed transition moves the copy to held_for_review. p-1's hold waits in awaiting_pickup while the edit adds a pending > 0 condition to open's copy.disputed transition and changes nothing inside awaiting_pickup. open is an ancestor of the active state, so it is in the configuration and its transition is selectable from there: the predicate answers false. The diff is breaking, open's transition (t_index 1) matching nothing on either side.
